verdict.rationale: Lever is an ATS, so recruiter-shaped application forms are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions custom application questions, knockout or screening rules, or EEOC/demographic data collection. The cited items cover an API endpoint for creating applications, career-site branding and contact forms, generic 'custom, flexible configurations', Automation Hub archiving, and an onboarding AI Form Builder, none of which describe application-form customization or compliant EEOC handling.
